name: std::extents<IndexType,Extents...>::static_extent

declarations.code: static constexpr std::size_t static_extent(rank_type i) noexcept;

intro: Returns static extent size of an extents at the rank index i. If the rank index i is a dynamic extent, returns std::dynamic_extent.

sections.title: Parameters
sections.text:
i

 -

 The rank index to get the static extent size of

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: The static extent size or std::dynamic_extent value.

summary: Returns static extent size of an extents at the rank index i. If the rank index i is a dynamic extent, returns std::dynamic_extent.
